# 🚨 edstem-cli 0.8.2

Security release. Commands and MCP tools behave as before.

> [!CAUTION]
> **Self-hosting the remote MCP server? Upgrade and redeploy now.**
> On 0.8.0 and earlier, a single oversized request to `/mcp` can exhaust server memory and take the server down ([GHSA-46jr-4wx8-v453](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-46jr-4wx8-v453)). With OAuth off, the sender needs no token.

## Who should upgrade

- 🔴 **Self-hosted remote server (Docker or your own Worker):** upgrade now.
- 🟡 **Local CLI or stdio `edstem-mcp`:** upgrade at your next update. This bug affects HTTP only.
- 🟢 **Hosted `edstem.tuuhub.com`:** already patched. Nothing to do.

## What was fixed

| Package | Change | Effect on edstem-cli |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server`, `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`, `agents` | 2.0.0 → 2.3.1, 1.30.0 → 1.32.1, 0.20.1 → 0.29.0 | Fixes the memory exhaustion above. The SDK's other advisories (shared instances, bearer audience, OAuth client, tasks) affect code paths edstem does not use. |
| `fast-uri`, `proxy-addr`, `qs`, `ip-address`, `hono` | patched | Pulled in by the SDK but not on edstem's request path. |
| `vitest`, `vite`, `wrangler`, `source-map-js` | upgraded | Development only. They are not in the npm package or the Worker. |

No compromised or malicious package was involved. `npm audit` reports 0 issues, down from 18 on 0.8.0. 0.8.2 also makes `edstem update` compare against the version you are running.

Use Node.js 22.23.4, 24.22.1, or 26.12.1, or a newer supported security patch.
